models.name: hrm_tracker_permissions
models.description:
Assigns permissions to roles within the organization.

This table defines which permissions are granted to each role. Each role can have multiple permissions, and each permission can be assigned to multiple roles (many-to-many relationship).

**Permission Values:**

- org:manage: Full organization management access
- employee:manage: Manage employees (invite, deactivate, view all)
- employee:view: View employee information
- project:manage: Manage projects, tasks, and project members
- project:view: View project information
- time:manage: Manage own timelogs and timers
- time:approve: Approve/reject timesheets
- time:view_all: View all timelogs across the organization
- report:view: Access organization reports

**Relationships:**

- Belongs to exactly one role (hrm_tracker_roles)
- One role can have many permissions

**Data Integrity:**

- Composite unique constraint on role_id and permission_name
- Foreign key to hrm_tracker_roles with CASCADE delete
- Permission names are validated at application level

**Usage:**

- Assigned to roles during role creation/editing
- Checked during authorization to grant/deny access
- Inherited by all employees with that role

**Example:**

- Manager role might have: project:manage, time:approve, report:view
- Employee role might have: project:view, time:manage, time:view_all

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the permission assignment record.

foreignFields.name: hrm_tracker_role_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged role's {@link hrm_tracker_roles.id}. The role to which this permission is assigned.

plainFields.name: permission
plainFields.description:
Permission code following org:entity:action format.

Allowed values:

- org:manage: Full organization management access
- employee:manage: Manage employees (invite, deactivate, view all)
- employee:view: View employee information
- project:manage: Manage projects, tasks, and project members
- project:view: View project information
- time:manage: Manage own timelogs and timers
- time:approve: Approve/reject timesheets
- time:view_all: View all timelogs across the organization
- report:view: Access organization reports

**Format**: `{resource}:{action}`

**Examples**:
- org:manage
- employee:manage
- project:manage
- time:approve

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission was assigned to the role.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was last modified.

models.name: hrm_tracker_timesheets
models.description:
Timesheet records that aggregate timelogs per employee per week for payroll and billing. Each timesheet represents a calendar week (Monday-Sunday) and tracks approval workflow status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected). Timesheets serve as the formal record for time tracking, with approved timesheets locking their timelogs to prevent modification.

Timesheets reference:
- Organization for multi-tenancy isolation
- Employee as the owner who created the timelogs
- Member who reviewed/approved the timesheet

All timesheet operations (create, edit, submit, approve, reject) follow strict business rules including employee-only creation and timelog locking on approval.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each timesheet record.

foreignFields.name: hrm_tracker_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Timesheet's organization for multi-tenancy isolation. {@link hrm_tracker_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_tracker_employee_id

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who reviewed/approved/rejected this timesheet. {@link hrm_tracker_members.id}. Nullable until timesheet is processed.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the week this timesheet covers (always Monday).

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the week this timesheet covers (always Sunday).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Timesheet status: draft (creating), submitted (submitted for approval), approved (approved by manager), rejected (rejected by manager).

plainFields.name: total_hours
plainFields.description: Calculated total hours across all timelogs in this timesheet.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when employee submitted this timesheet for approval.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when manager reviewed/approved/rejected this timesheet.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by manager when rejecting the timesheet. Empty when timesheet is approved or in draft/submitted status.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Nullable until timesheet is deleted.

Only one contract can be active (is_active = true) per employee at any given time. Past contracts are immutable and preserved for auditing and reporting purposes.

models.name: hrm_tracker_activity_logs
models.description: Activity log records significant system actions for audit trail purposes. Each entry captures who performed the action (actor), what action was performed, which entity was affected (target), when it happened, and additional details. Supports actions like employee management (invited/deactivated/reactivated), contract changes, project lifecycle events (created/archived/completed/deleted), task status changes, timesheet workflow actions (submitted/approved/rejected), and role assignments. This table serves as the system's audit trail to track all significant business events for compliance and debugging.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this activity log entry was created.

models.name: hrm_tracker_timers
models.description:
Active timer entry for employees tracking time in real-time. Each employee can have at most one active timer at any given time. The timer records the project (required) and optional task being worked on, along with description and start timestamp. When stopped, a timelog is created from this timer state. Organization-scoped for multi-tenancy isolation.

**Key constraints**:
- One active timer per employee (@@unique([employee_id, deleted_at]))
- Project reference is mandatory
- Task reference is optional but must belong to the selected project
- Timer state is ephemeral and automatically converted to timelog on stop

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timer. {@link hrm_tracker_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project being tracked (required). {@link hrm_tracker_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task being tracked (must belong to selected project). {@link hrm_tracker_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context for multi-tenancy isolation. {@link hrm_tracker_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the work being tracked.

plainFields.name: start_timestamp
plainFields.description: When the timer was started (ISO 8601 datetime).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (null = active, non-null = deleted).
